Malaysia PM meets Myanmar leader amid protests over reintegration

Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim met with Myanmar's military-backed leader Min Aung Hlaing in Malaysia to discuss migrant repatriation. The visit occurred amidst protests by activists concerned about Myanmar's potential full reintegration into ASEAN. Malaysia's Prime Minister stated that the country will work towards Myanmar's reintegration into the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.
